one_liner: systeme.io has a REST public API authenticated with a self-generated X-API-Key, plus an official hosted MCP server using MCP keys. Builders can generate keys from account settings.
auth_notes: The official docs say the API key in the X-API-Key header is the only option. Up to 3 keys per account, with optional expiry. A third-party Rollout guide describes OAuth, but the official docs do not support it.
access_notes: Keys are generated in the dashboard under Settings > MCP & API keys. The evidence does not mention a plan requirement for API access, so whether a free account suffices is not confirmed.
blocker_notes: Per-user API keys are required rather than OAuth. This is not a blocker. Whether the free plan includes API access was not verified.

evidence.quote: To authenticate with the Systeme.io Public API, your only option right now is to attach your API key to the `X-API-Key` header of each request.
Scroll down to the Public API keys section and click **Create** (3).
Adhering to RESTful conventions, our API ensures an intuitive and consistent interaction pattern for all users.
allowing you to manage contacts, tags, and a variety of other operations integral to our platform.
